questions.prompt: How does the episode frame exercise?

options.text: Movement has many forms beyond running or lifting.
Only an expensive gym can help.

questions.explanation: It introduces a broad view of activity rather than a single sport or routine.

questions.prompt: What connection does the sea squirt example illustrate?

options.text: Learning and nervous systems are tied to movement.
All animals need the same exercise plan.
Studying eliminates the need to move.

questions.explanation: The example links the need to navigate an environment with the usefulness of a brain.

questions.prompt: What broader idea closes the course?

options.text: Learning is separate from the body.
More desk time is always better.
Caring for the body is part of supporting the brain.

questions.explanation: The final episode places learning within whole-body care.
